plugins.name: Art SQL API
plugins.author: bertrandom
plugins.description: Read-only SQL over HTTP (Datasette-style JSON) for the Art app's artapp.db, on its own LAN port with an API key. Uses the TV's sqlite3. No outbound connections.

plugins.name: Bedtime
plugins.author: piecifra
plugins.description: Turn the TV off at set times or after a sleep timer, or open an app on a schedule. No network.

plugins.name: 8BitDo Guide
plugins.author: augusto1024
plugins.description: Open the Vetro launcher with Guide on the Bluetooth 8BitDo Ultimate 2 Wireless; forward other buttons and axes. No network access.

plugins.name: NordVPN
plugins.author: piecifra
plugins.description: NordVPN (NordLynx/WireGuard) on the TV: country, kill switch, reconnect. Talks to api.nordvpn.com, NordVPN servers and GitHub (its binary).

plugins.name: Prometheus exporter
plugins.author: piecifra
plugins.description: Prometheus metrics for the TV: CPU, memory, swap, network, Wi-Fi signal, SoC temperature, uptime. Reads /proc and /sys only; no network.

plugins.name: Shell
plugins.author: piecifra
plugins.description: A root shell on the TV from the dashboard, one command at a time; cd is remembered.

plugins.name: SSH server
plugins.author: bertrandom
plugins.description: A real SSH-2 server in pure JS (no binary): interactive ssh is a root line-shell, ssh root@tv 'cmd' runs as root, plus scp/sftp. Needs Node 10+.

plugins.name: TV uptime
plugins.author: andrearicci93
plugins.description: Shows how long the TV has been on. Reads /proc/uptime through the TV agent (needs the exec permission).

plugins.name: Ad-free YouTube
plugins.author: andrearicci93
plugins.description: Samsung's own YouTube with ads blocked, Shorts hidden and sponsors skipped (TizenTube). Local proxy; fetches one pinned script from cdn.jsdelivr.net.
